descriptions.text: The Enchanted Hairbrush of the Beefmaster. This item may only be used on a male with an average hair length of 25 centimeters or longer. This item may only be used on a single person, once per day. Samson. Fabio. Michael Bolton. Jim Morrison. The entire band Stryper. Yanni. Your history is filled with luscious men whose power resided in their lovely locks. Now, it's your turn. If you use this magical hairbrush upon your head for five minutes straight, you will receive the following benefits for the next thirty hours: The Shining Charisma benefit. The Speedster benefit. Plus 25% to your constitution. Level 10 Entourage. Plus your hair will be shiny and healthy, and it will goddamn glisten.

beats.headline: It screams
beats.text: Katia notices Carl no longer ties his hair back; with his new hairbrush, he says, it is easier to keep it out. In the interview bubble, Kevin calls up Carl's very different celestial item, his third. Unlike Donut's magic hairbrush, which looks ordinary, it is shining gold with a jewelled handle, and every stroke through his hair screams like women cheering at a rock concert. When he stops, it shouts Encore! Encore! for two minutes. It works only on a man whose hair averages twenty-five centimetres, once a day.

beats.headline: Too good to give up
beats.text: The constitution alone makes the brush frustratingly invaluable, just like his boxers: now too good to give up, so the haircut he planned for when the tonic's regrowth ebbed is off. Shining Charisma lends his party a fifth of his charisma. Entourage, a bard skill for Donut, mirrors party members in illusion. Speedster flashes him across short distances in seconds, and combined with Gloom Wraith Phase it carries him much further phased. Mordecai has never seen Speedster awarded like this.

beats.headline: Under the hood
beats.text: Every food box now comes out liquefied, fish-smelling and burned to a crisp, and Carl still has to eat once a day to keep his buffs. In the suit he cannot reset his foot buff, so it will expire. Nor can he brush his hair, because the hood is firmly attached to his head.
